name: The Final Piece
label: Quest
description: The Final Piece: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The log you found on the high chief looks extensive, but after looking through a couple of the pages, you find that you cannot read the text. The markings are so crude and poorly-formed that you are not sure if anyone would be able to read them.
But perhaps Donova will be able to tell you what it says...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wonder what all of this means... I can't make anything out...
